The curves lie below the data at z > 2 beyond a resolution-dependent redshift, where the haloes that dominate star formation are no longer resolved; the kink at z = 7.8 is reionization photo-heating and the small one at z = 2.9 the change of softening, as the paper explains. The paper does not say whether the density is comoving; the observational compilation in the same panel (Behroozi+19, Novak+17, Gruppioni+20, Enia+22, Khusanova+21) is comoving and the curves agree with it at z < 2, so comoving is inferred.
